messages.message: ### Step 1: Source-Reference Alignment & Semantic Analysis Task: Align source tokens to the provided Reference Translation; pick in-context sense + grammatical role. Output: (a) Interpretation Lock FIRST (one bullet per source line): - Line <ID> <copy exact source line> => Locked Meaning (truth-conditions) - If comparative/degree: define entities A,B, relation (>,<,≈), and degree (e.g., "slightly"). - Note: A>B is equivalent to B<A; do not reverse the ordering. (b) THEN ONE Markdown table consistent with the Lock: - [Source Word] | [Morphology] | [Reference Equivalent] | [Contextual Definition] | [Grammatical Role] Source Text: 70 Nacqui sub Iulio, ancor che fosse tardi, 71 e vissi a Roma sotto 'l buono Augusto 72 nel tempo de li dèi falsi e bugiardi. Reference Translation (provided): I was born sub Julio, though late, and I lived at Rome under the good Augustus, in the time of the false and lying gods.

**Interpretation Lock – FIRST (one bullet per source line)**
- **Line 70** *“Nacqui sub Iulio, ancor che fosse tardi,”* → **Locked Meaning**: The speaker asserts that his birth event (**Nacqui**) took place **under the rule/time of Julio** (the prepositional phrase *sub Iulio*) and that this birth occurred **later than the expected or normative time**. The concessive clause *ancor che fosse* (“although it was”) marks the lateness as a noteworthy circumstance.
*Comparative/degree*: - **A** = the actual time of the speaker’s birth - **B** = the culturally‑expected or “proper” time of birth - **Relation** = A > B (the birth is later) - **Degree** = simply “late” (no finer gradation is expressed).
- **Line 71** *“e vissi a Roma sotto ’l buono Augusto”* → **Locked Meaning**: The speaker states that he **lived** (**vissi**) **in Rome** (*a Roma*) **during the period when the good Augustus ruled**, the latter expressed by the prepositional phrase *sotto ’l buono Augusto* (“under the good Augustus”).
- **Line 72** *“nel tempo de li dèi falsi e bugiardi.”* → **Locked Meaning**: The speaker situates his life **in the time** (*nel tempo*) **that belongs to the false and lying gods** (*de li dèi falsi e bugiardi*), i.e., a historical epoch characterized by deceitful divine narratives.
